description_en: Queries the compliance results of member accounts in a specified compliance package within a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内指定合规包中成员账号的合规结果
kebab_example: aliyun config get-aggregate-account-compliance-by-pack --compliance-pack-id cp-541e626622af00870000 --aggregator-id ca-04b3fd170e3400070000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAggregateAccountComplianceByPack

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package ID.

For information about how to obtain the compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en:
The account group ID.

For information about how to obtain the account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

AccountComplianceResult.description_en: The compliance results of member accounts in the compliance package
AccountComplianceResult.description_zh: 合规包中成员账号的合规结果

AccountCompliances.description_en: The compliance results of member accounts
AccountCompliances.description_zh: 成员账号的合规结果列表

AccountId.description_en: The ID of one of the member accounts in the account group

AccountName.description_en: The name of one of the member accounts in the account group
AccountName.description_zh: 账号组中的成员账号名称

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance type. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: Compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: Non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: Not applicable.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data
ComplianceType.description_zh:
合规类型。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据

NonCompliantCount.description_en: The number of non-compliant member accounts

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of member accounts
